visualReview.notes: Every standard frame inspected: both staggered rounded blades, three lower fingers, lift link, glazed atrium, entrance canopy, white floor bands and roof screens are present without missing wall/roof faces.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Every shared frame inspected, including roof detail, atrium, all angles and north-up placement. Shared painted metal and concrete resolve; tinted glass and deterministic sun blinds retain their fallback material. No per-model photographic textures are required.

geographicReview.notes: The two tall blade polygons retain their exact mapped QIDs and positions. The footprint overlay represents the 1 m ground platform, so northwest upper projections correctly extend beyond it rather than being moved into the platform. The three lower round ends and atrium preserve the asymmetric esplanade-facing orientation.

fidelityReview.notes: Passed for the detailed complete exterior reconstruction at world-viewer scale. Published engineer heights/floor counts, separate tall-blade footprints and the photographed white-ribbon glazing rhythm are represented. Blind positions and small roof equipment are reconstructed rather than claimed as permanent measured details.
